snippet.title: Lords of the Fallen mobile version - Trailer (iOS/Android)
snippet.description:
Pick up the sword and put down some monsters. In a world of grotesque fiends, the only thing that stands between annihilation and survival is the cold hard steel in your hands. Do you have what it takes to live another day in Lords of the Fallen?
Lords of the Fallen will be available on the Apple Store and Google Play on February 9, 2017.
